=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: compact_validation_summary_value(), lines 1657-1661
  Problem: The `tr '\r\n' '  '` command does not translate the two-character sequence `\r\n` to spaces. In `tr`, `'\r\n'` is a set of individual characters: it translates `\r` to space and `\n` to space independently. While the effect happens to be acceptable (both characters become spaces), the expression is misleading and will also translate any standalone `\r` or `\n` anywhere in the input, not just the CRLF sequence. If the intent was to normalize only line breaks, this is fine; but if a future maintainer reads this expecting CRLF-only handling, it is confusing.
  Why it fails at runtime: Does not cause a runtime failure; the current behavior collapses all whitespace uniformly, which is the intended downstream effect. This is a correctness nit only.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
  SEVERITY: NIT
- File: scripts/validate_process.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 3207-3208 (enforce_managed_validation_artifact_contract failure) and lines 3211-3213 (non-directory validation/ path guard)
  Problem: These two `exit 1` paths terminate the script without calling `write_result_files`, so they bypass `emit_validation_failure_summary` and produce no `VALIDATION_FAILURE_SUMMARY` telemetry line. Both are non-pass terminal states of the validate run: the artifact-contract enforcement failure and the validation/ path type guard.
  Why it fails at runtime: The linked issue requires "one stable VALIDATION_FAILURE_SUMMARY line on every non-pass terminal path." These two paths exit without any summary line, so the observability requirement is unmet. A collector listening for `VALIDATION_FAILURE_SUMMARY` will miss these failure modes entirely.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
